## About C-Entrepreneurs
C-Entrepreneurs is a technology and marketing agency headquartered in Karur, Tamil Nadu (PIN: 639001). The company specializes in custom software development, POS billing software, responsive web design, Android mobile apps, and data-driven digital marketing (SEO, Meta Ads, Google Ads). In addition, C-Entrepreneurs runs a hands-on startup accelerator and student internship incubator.
